name: IsTopologicalRing.of_nhds_zero
statement: Tendsto (uncurry ((· + ·) : R → R → R)) (𝓝 0 ×ˢ 𝓝 0) <| 𝓝 0) (hneg : Tendsto (fun x => -x : R → R) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)) (hmul : Tendsto (uncurry ((· * ·) : R → R → R)) (𝓝 0 ×ˢ 𝓝 0) <| 𝓝 0) (hmul_left : ∀ x₀ : R, Tendsto (fun x : R => x₀ * x) (𝓝 0) <| 𝓝 0) (hmul_right : ∀ x₀ : R, Tendsto (fun x : R => x * x₀) (𝓝 0) <| 𝓝 0) (hleft : ∀ x₀ : R, 𝓝 x₀ = map (fun x => x₀ + x) (𝓝 0)) : IsTopologicalRing R
